svg.title: Pulling a window to the monitor you are on
svg.desc: A mouse, four steps, and two monitors. The cursor is on the left monitor. With both monitors on: the blue window's icon is clicked on the left monitor's taskbar, Mouse4 is held, the middle button is clicked, and the blue window comes from the right monitor to the left one; then Mouse4 is released. Then a finger presses the right monitor's power button and its screen goes black, leaving a grey dotted outline where the red window is. The same steps bring the red window out of the dark monitor to the left one, and the cursor leaves the screen.
